package.name: x30_localization
package.description: Where the X30 is on its site (the ROS Noetic port of dharma_localization, without a map): map -> odom from an SE(2) EKF on top of FAST-LIO, the odometry's start as the map origin, corrected by fiducials in view and operator pose estimates through a chi-square gate that grows with the uncertainty, and the bridge of FAST-LIO's frames into a gravity-aligned odom -> base_link.
